blocks.text: Thanks for the census extract. It came through clean, and David Sherman is reconciling it against last year's file now. The head counts and covered payroll tie so far, and he will flag anything that does not before it reaches the model.

Jeffrey Ochoa has the {{fact:f:E-2016-001.client}} valuation set up on last cycle's basis, so the assumptions are ready to load once the data is final. We are not running numbers yet; at this stage the work is getting the inputs right.

A couple of items are still open on your side. We need the year-end asset statement, and a read on whether the disability offset follows the plan document or the summary, since the two disagree. For our reliance file I am recording Elizabeth Horne as the source of the plan data; if either item should come from someone else on your team, tell me and I will note it.

Once those two are settled, David can close the reconciliation and Jeffrey can produce a first set of results for our own review. Nothing goes to you until we have checked it against the prior valuation and are comfortable it holds.
